headline: Jammy The Bull: Durk Sent Me to Commit Murder, Now He's a Money Leader?
body: DJ Akademiks reports Jammy The Bull (OTF JAM) claims Durk ordered him to commit murder ahead of a verdict day. 'Durk sent me off, told me to do a murder and when he found out cops were onto them, he didn’t even warn us,' Jammy says. He questions Durk's leadership in OTF, arguing money, not military experience, got Durk his position. The post has 3,468 likes and 1,648 comments.

caption:
Jammy The Bull (OTF JAM) is speaking out ahead of a critical verdict day. He alleges Durk directed him to commit a murder but failed to warn him when police were closing in. Jammy challenges Durk's leadership, stating money, not combat experience, made him the OTF leader. The post has sparked intense debate among fans.
